scope.purpose: national-volume reference workload for ingestion, spatial indexing and population-table alignment
scope.claim_scope: bounded national reference inputs; not a national service, completeness, accessibility or performance claim

permitted: measure archive readback and normalized geography workload size
exercise population workbook parsing and schema checks
record that both snapshots cover New Zealand with different geographic units and editions
prohibited: assign regional or territorial population to Meshblocks
downscale or interpolate population to Meshblocks
claim population-weighted accessibility or denominator validity
claim national completeness from these two snapshots alone

correctness_oracles: each packet manifest and checksums file
geography object-ID inventory and projection record
population workbook SHA-256, byte length, edition markers and worksheet count

non_claims: The population workbook is provisional and is not a Meshblock-level denominator.
The geography snapshot supplies supporting geometry only; it contains no population observations.
This manifest does not establish national accessibility, network coverage, service completeness, cost, capacity or operational performance.
A later exact-edition population or boundary change requires a new manifest identity.
